title: Balloon Pop
tagline: Pop smiley, heart, bunny and star balloons over a sunny countryside!
howToPlay: Tap or click a balloon to pop it (or steer the pin with the arrow keys and press Space). Fill the bar to reach the next level and meet new balloons: golden balloons with a crown are worth 5, a star pops every balloon, and a rainbow makes baby balloons. Tap the sun, a sheep, a house, a tree, the windmill or the hot-air balloon for a surprise. Nothing is ever lost, so just keep popping!
